user.title: GrillEye Classic
user.description: Enter the GrillEye MAC, not the Shelly proxy MAC. An offline device can be added; readings stay unavailable until a valid live advertisement arrives.

init.title: Reception and readings
init.description: Timeout: 30–3600 seconds, default 120. Only allow 0 °C after checking firmware and unplugged probes: unused channels may also send zero. This option applies to all channels. Saving reloads and waits for a live packet.
